algorithm.name: ascending-average shifted local spike 50x5
algorithm.description: Sort by complexityScore ascending. For each 5-level small group, pick the challenge from a shifted higher-score position in the remaining pool, then fill four setup slots from the lowest remaining scores.
algorithm.selectionReason: Shift 13 is the first tested shift with no average-trend or challenge violations and a median challenge delta close to the previous 4-100 proposal.
